translation:
Treats all wind disorders and injuries.

Baixianpi/Dictamnus bark, Baizhu/Atractylodes macrocephala, Shaoyao/Peony, Rougui/Cinnamon (remove the coarse bark), Chuanxiong/Ligusticum, Chuan Danggui/Angelica (remove the root), Xingren/apricot kernel (remove the skin and tip), Fangfeng/Saposhnikovia, Gancao/Licorice, each two liang, Duhuo/Radix Angelicae pubescentis, Mahuang/Ephedra (remove the root and nodes), Bai Fuling/Poria, each three liang. The above: each time take two qian, with one and a half cups of water and four slices of ginger, decoct until eight-tenths remains, and take without regard to time. It is also appropriate to use Xuming Tang and Xiaofeng San.
